sql:
SELECT 
  `tc`.`course_name` AS '课程名称',
  COUNT(`te`.`id`) AS '报名人数'
FROM `training_course` `tc`
INNER JOIN `training_session` `ts` ON `ts`.`course_id` = `tc`.`id`
INNER JOIN `training_enrollment` `te` ON `te`.`session_id` = `ts`.`id`
GROUP BY `tc`.`id`, `tc`.`course_name`
ORDER BY COUNT(`te`.`id`) DESC

SELECT `tc`.`course_name` AS '课程名称', COUNT(`te`.`id`) AS '报名人数'
FROM `training_course` `tc`
INNER JOIN `training_session` `ts` ON `ts`.`course_id` = `tc`.`id`
INNER JOIN `training_enrollment` `te` ON `te`.`session_id` = `ts`.`id`
GROUP BY `tc`.`id`, `tc`.`course_name`
ORDER BY COUNT(`te`.`id`) DESC
LIMIT 200

SELECT `tc`.`course_name` AS `课程名称`, COUNT(`te`.`id`) AS `报名人数`
FROM `training_enrollment` `te`
INNER JOIN `training_session` `ts` ON `te`.`session_id` = `ts`.`id`
INNER JOIN `training_course` `tc` ON `ts`.`course_id` = `tc`.`id`
GROUP BY `tc`.`id`, `tc`.`course_name`
ORDER BY `报名人数` DESC
